author: Nate Miller
title: Bligh Madris released by Cardinals
desc: Bligh Madris was granted his release by the Cardinals.
impact: Madris will pursue playing opportunities overseas in Korea. The 30-year-old has spent the entire season with Triple-A, posting a strong .908 OPS with 14 homers over 71 games.

author: Nate Miller
title: Bruce Zimmerman sent to Triple-A
desc: Bruce Zimmerman was outrighted back to Triple-A on Sunday.
impact: Zimmerman was designated for assignment last week. The lefty reliever subsequently cleared waivers and was sent back to Triple-A by the Cardinals.

author: Nate Miller
title: Ha-Seong Kim (finger) will start a rehab assignment Monday
desc: Ha-Seong Kim (finger) will begin a rehab assignment with the FCL Braves on Monday.
impact: It's been a rough year for Kim. He didn't make his season debut until May 12. When he did finally get going, the 30-year-old shortstop struggled mightily at the plate, managing only five hits and nine walks over 82 plate appearances before being placed back on the IL at the end of June. Kim will pick things back up on Monday in Florida, hoping to reset for after the All-Star break.

author: Nate Miller
title: Ronald Acuna Jr. (hamstring) beginning rehab assignment
desc: Ronald Acuna Jr. (hamstring) will begin a rehab assignment on Monday.
impact: Acuna is progressing toward a return to the Braves' lineup, as he will get some in-game action at rookie ball in Florida on Monday. Acuna has been on the shelf for the past month due to his second hamstring injury of the season. The Braves have taken it slower this time with their star lead-off man, but their lineup has struggled to find consistency since Acuna went down.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Shane Baz racks up 9 Ks but can't finish five in win
desc: Shane Baz allowed one earned run on seven hits and no walks while striking out nine over 4.2 innings in Sunday's 8-2 win over the Royals.
impact: After the outing, he owns a 4.11 ERA and 1.38 WHIP with a 4-9 record across 19 starts. Baz will likely pitch in the third game out of the All-Star break for the O's.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Samuel Basallo goes deep as Orioles thump Royals 8-2
desc: Samuel Basallo went 1-for-5 in Sunday's 8-2 win over the Royals with a home run, a run scored, and one RBI.
impact: Through 83 games this season, Basallo is slashing .248/.309/.464 with 16 home runs, 46 RBI, and 34 runs scored.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Leody Taveras cashes in with a three-RBI blast in 8-2 win
desc: Leody Taveras went 2-for-4 in the win over the Royals with a home run, two runs scored, three RBI, and one strikeout.
impact: After Sunday's win over Kansas City, Taveras is slashing .237/.314/.364 with four homers, 34 RBI, 35 runs scored and 10 steals across 82 games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Gunnar Henderson logs three hits in 8-2 win over Royals
desc: Gunnar Henderson went 3-for-5 in a win over the Royals with a run scored, an RBI and two strikeouts.
impact: After Sunday's win, Henderson is slashing .224/.294/.403 with 17 home runs, seven stolen bases, 43 RBI and 55 runs scored across 96 games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Cade Cavalli solid, but Nats bullpen blinks in 5-3 loss
desc: Cade Cavalli allowed two earned runs on four hits and one walk while striking out five over six innings in Sunday's loss to the Yankees.
impact: Cade Cavalli exits the first half of the season with a 3.83 ERA and 1.35 WHIP with a 5-4 record across 20 starts this season.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Curtis Mead's Blast Not Enough in 5-3 Loss
desc: Curtis Mead went 1-for-2 against the Yankees with a home run, a run scored and one RBI.
impact: Mead is batting .247 with 17 homers, 44 RBI, 42 runs scored and five stolen bases across 80 games. Mead will look to continue the best season of his career after the All-Star break.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: James Wood tags Yankees with a long ball in Sunday's loss
desc: James Wood went 1-for-2 in loss to the Yankees with a home run, two walks, one run scored, one RBI and one strikeout.
impact: After Sunday's loss to New York, Wood is slashing .279/.410/.575 with 28 homers, 89 runs, 64 RBI and 15 steals through 97 games. Wood ends the first half of the season ranked first in the NL in runs and second in home runs.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Petey Halpin's bat stays quiet, but his legs still show up
desc: Petey Halpin continues to bring more speed than thump to Cleveland's outfield mix.
impact: Petey Halpin went 1-for-3 in a 5-2 win over the Marlins on Sunday with one walk, one stolen base, and one strikeout. After Sunday's win over Miami, Halpin is batting .180 with no home runs, one RBI, nine runs, and four stolen bases across 31 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Kahlil Watson Swipes Bag, Drives In Run in Win
desc: Kahlil Watson went 2-for-5 in Sunday's 5-2 win over the Marlins with an RBI, a stolen base, and a strikeout.
impact: Watson's speed continues to create problems for the opposition. After Sunday's win over the Marlins, the rookie is batting .221 with one home run, 10 RBI, five runs scored, and eight stolen bases across 23 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Steven Kwan Chips In, Still Waiting on the Bat to Wake Up
desc: Steven Kwan went 2-for-4 in Sunday's 5-2 win over the Marlins with one stolen base and one strikeout.
impact: Kwan did his usual table-setting thing, but the overall line still looks like a guy stuck in neutral. After the win, Kwan is batting .225 with one home run, 16 RBI, 37 runs scored, and six stolen bases across 89 games. His overall line isn't great but he's been hot of late, hitting .316 over his past seven contests.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Travis Bazzana scores twice despite hitless day
desc: Travis Bazzana went 0-for-3 in a 5-2 win over the Marlins on Sunday with two runs scored, two walks, one stolen base, and one strikeout.
impact: Bazzana managed to be a factor anyway, even without a hit. After Sunday's win over Miami, Bazzana is batting .238 with seven home runs, 28 RBI, 30 runs scored, and 13 stolen bases across 65 games. He has been cold of late, hitting just .167 over his past 15 games.
